sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining — accessing a property on nil silently returns nil, propagating absence without error
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone who isn't there doesn't crash the world; it just quietly yields nothing.

sketches.mechanism: The 'object' keyword creates a singleton — exactly one instance can ever exist, enforced by the language
sketches.resonance: Loneliness is not a feeling but a structural constraint: the language guarantees there will never be another.

sketches.mechanism: A function declared with a return type that never returns — the compiler trusts the promise, but the value is never delivered
sketches.resonance: Some promises compile perfectly but never produce what they declared they would.
